tasks.title: Certified plain JSON bypasses copying and matches the frozen copy path
tasks.spec: ## Repository: contract, Task b; required behaviors 1, 2, 4, 5 and 6; counterexamples 1-10 and 12-15 in the differential suite, and existing case-11 tests. Freeze the 7ce23aa reference before adding the walk. Use schema-compiled private walks, captured built-ins, technique A or the complete technique-B call integrity check, no input trust cache and only the allowed descriptor allocations. Certify own data and plain prototypes at each level, including absent-key inheritance and the once-per-call enumerable Object.prototype check; records, multi-option unions and lazy object/function values retain the specified copy fallback. Keep APIs, schemas, types, wire version and dependency pins unchanged. Replace only the named Proxy descriptor/get test with Validation/no-throw assertions and update problem's comment. Follow Task b's before-walk green run, two throwaway red runs and final green run in order.

acceptance.expected: With task_pr_base set to the PR branch-base SHA, no output, excluding T1's commits. If upstream changed these files relative to the frozen baseline, request the hold required by behavior 6 instead of substituting a new reference.
No differences except the optional single leading source/freeze comment allowed by behavior 6. The immutable git object is the independent source. Save the diff for the PR.

Only the schema import changes from ./schema.ts to ../../src/schema.ts, plus the optional single leading source/freeze comment. arrayProblem still reads value[i] in this reference. Save the diff for the PR.
Reference imports are limited to zod, ../../src/schema.ts and ./validate-core.ts; no import of candidate src/validate-core.ts, src/validate.ts or src/index.ts.

Before adding the walk, on the branch with T1 complete: 0 failing tests. Each of the 26 validate* exports and 6 schema-level pairs has valid JSON and wrong-typed-field entries; every entry checks literal results, verdict, exact first-error text and success identity against the frozen reference. The only exception entries are counterexample 1 for uptime/latency and counterexample 2: reference ok:true with input identity, candidate rejects with their literal errors. Unicode and fixed-depth entries satisfy the same literals required by the after-walk check below. If the reference misses a depth literal on this machine, leave the test failing and request a hold with measured values; do not loosen it. Focused coverage exit status is not the gate.

Throwaway red run 1 only: run in a clean worktree of 7ce23aaf3fa3e038f65ecfed755188b83bde143f with only the new differential suite and frozen reference copied in. Counterexamples 1 and 2 fail because the candidate accepts inherited elements; no other entry fails. Record entry names and messages. Never commit this run's setup.

Throwaway red run 2 only: apply the Counterexamples historical-walk recipe to that 7ce23aa worktree, omitting the duplicate lookupGetter declaration and leaving arrayProblem unchanged. Differential entries 1-4, 9, 13 and 14 fail at least; 13a-c count 1, 13d gives check.headers: must be an object, and 14a-c count above 0. The expected 11 existing failures are the eight admin tests at baseline lines 397, 465, 510, 559, 637, 662, 689 and 710; tokens tests at 283 and 313; and the unrebuilt-dist smoke test. List any additional failure by name/message, including any depth-suite failure; report any unexpected existing-test failure. Save results for the PR and never commit the historical walk.

After the walk: 0 failing tests, including counterexamples 1-10 and 12-15. Corpus includes raw JSON duplicate keys parsed before validation, own __proto__, huge/non-finite-looking numbers, lone surrogates (raw and escaped), 50 astral characters, NFC/NFD keys, competing errors and both nesting kinds per 15g. Literal verdicts/errors match Verified state and Counterexamples; the NFC/NFD result is exactly the JS string literal "component: has an unknown field: caf\u00e9, cafe\u0301". Both keys and the expected text use only \u escapes in the test source, with no literal accented character and no normalization, sorting or error reordering. Getter counts for 6, 8, 13 and 14 are 0 and never exceed the reference. Pollution is isolated/restored with finally and schemas are warmed before pollution; mutation case 8 revalidates. For nested arrays and nested objects separately, at each of depths 1000, 5000, 10000 and 100000, call candidate and reference 3 times each, alternating, with a fresh JSON-parsed input for each call. At 1000 and 5000 every call on both sides is ok:true with value === input; at 10000 and 100000 every call is exactly {ok:false,error:"check: is not a valid value"}. Every call must equal its literal; depth adds no equivalence exception. Test no other depth, search for no limit, and permit no alternative outcome. If the reference misses a depth literal on this machine, leave the test failing and request a hold with measured values; do not loosen it. The suite contains no Proxy and its exception entries remain exactly cases 1 and 2. Focused coverage exit status is not the gate.

tasks.title: CPU meets the historical baseline bound and the PR documents the guarantee

Add the standalone CPU runner, document own-data elements at every level, the proven-equivalence guarantee and its two exceptions, and bump package version 1.7.0 to 1.7.1. README.md changes only if it repeats the rule; validate.bench.test.ts changes only if fixtures move. src/validate-core.ts and its dist outputs change only if optimization is needed to meet the unchanged 10% CPU bound, preserving every safety check and rerunning the differential/full suite. Collect the complete PR evidence and applicable security checklist for the whole change.
